q: Devaney's definition of chaos requires three conditions. Which of the following is NOT one of them?
opts: Positive Lyapunov exponent for all orbits
exp: Devaney chaos: (1) transitive, (2) dense periodic points, (3) sensitive dependence. Interestingly, (1)+(2) imply (3) by a theorem of Banks et al. Positive Lyapunov exponent is a stronger metric condition, not part of Devaney's topological definition.
